association.co2_series_used: NOAA GML global marine-surface monthly means (co2_mm_gl), annual mean of complete years; no interpolated months
association.exclusion_rule: Years need 12 monthly CO2 values and a GISTEMP global annual value. The Mauna Loa series is shown for context but not used: 196 of its 823 monthly rows carry NOAA's negative-sdev flag (interpolated or pre-daily record).
association.interpretation: ASSOCIATION ONLY. Both series trend upward, so the level correlation (0.95) is high largely by construction and says nothing on its own about cause. Year-to-year changes correlate far less (0.19, slope interval includes zero) because other drivers such as El Nino dominate annual variability; after removing each series' linear trend the correlation is 0.53. The physical attribution rests on radiative physics and the IPCC assessment, not on this regression.

mlo_site_note: Mauna Loa observations were suspended 2022-11-29 to 2023-07 after the eruption and resumed at the Maunakea Observatories about 21 miles north (NOAA file header). Months in the gap are interpolated and flagged.
note: CO2 and temperature are displayed side by side. No causal or predictive model is fitted.
sentinels: NOAA MLO flags interpolated or no-daily-data months with sdev < 0 / unc < 0 / ndays = -1 (the file header: 'Missing months have been interpolated, for NOAA data indicated by negative stdev and uncertainty'). The deseasonalized column is a real value in those rows. The global file has no flagged rows.
